summary: The candidate is a valid partial runtime correction for DeepSeek-V4.1 C2 pending-row geometry: it transfers one endpoint-local FP32 row at odd committed boundaries and none at even boundaries, including unequal ring capacities and request slots. It does not verify or complete the original end-to-end PD + DSpark feature contract.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction at base 358c163: legal R=2/N=101 raised ValueError; R=8/N=101 returned five rows; R=8/N=102 returned six rows instead of no payload. The imported sglang source was /job/repo/python/sglang/__init__.py.
At exact candidate 88a6a9e, 93 focused wire/Mooncake/NIXL tests and 17 subtests passed.

tests.command: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-1257d67e0bf0/venv/bin/python inline independent mapping and GPU copy probe
tests.what_was_measured: 104,000 mappings across distinct endpoint request slots, rings 2/4/8/16/32, and N=0..259 matched the independent formula; invalid rings were rejected. On AMD Instinct MI350X, exactly one 4096-byte FP32 row copied from source index 2 to destination index 28 and adjacent rows remained unchanged.

gpu_execution.evidence: Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2/HIP 7.2.26015 on AMD Instinct MI350X executed the independent row-copy check. This validates C2 row geometry/device copying only, not DSpark or generation.

native_rebuild_evidence: No C/C++/CUDA/HIP/header/Cython or other native source differs between the recorded base and candidate; no native rebuild was applicable. The loaded aiter core was the prepared runtime artifact under /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-1257d67e0bf0/cache/aiter/module_aiter_core.so.
remaining_counterexamples: No end-to-end DeepSeek-V4.1 PD + DSpark generation was run with Mooncake or NIXL.
Streaming and concurrent request behavior remain unverified.
Chunked prefill and prefix-cache restoration, including odd prefix hits and separation of H from N, remain unverified; decode radix cache remains explicitly incompatible with speculative decoding.
First draft/verify, partial and full rejection, accepted-token commit, C2 reuse, and Engram-history updates remain unverified end to end.
Cancellation, stale-write prevention, transfer-before-execution/source-release ordering, and request-slot reuse remain unverified.
Generation parity against non-disaggregated DeepSeek-V4.1, actual speculative acceptance, and throughput remain unmeasured.
The prepared ROCm/HIP platform cannot execute DSpark because _handle_dspark accepts only device strings beginning with cuda or npu.
No DeepSeek-V4.1 target/draft weights or real multi-process/cross-node Mooncake/NIXL topology were available.
remaining_limitations: GPU evidence is limited to row selection and copy correctness on ROCm; it does not qualify the CUDA/NPU-only DSpark execution path.

The deterministic tiny Llama fixture cannot validate DeepSeek-V4.1 architecture state, DSpark speculative semantics, or distributed Mooncake/NIXL transport, so it was not presented as original-issue evidence.

Candidate PR base bd45cd50ca900dd821f829ca9adfbf9aa3336bda differs from the campaign's recorded comparison base 358c163250ad3b1f62939b01ce1314a0a31a0365; this review used the required recorded base for failing-before evidence.
